name: Kashmir Winter Honeymoon
route: Srinagar · Dal Lake · Tangmarg · Gulmarg · Pampore · Pahalgam · Aru or Betaab
description: A seven-day private winter escape for two, with two nights each in Gulmarg and Pahalgam and a lakeside Srinagar finish.
quoteReason: Owner-authorised planning estimate. Supplier costs, hotel selection, taxes and exact inclusions must be checked before a final offer.

itinerary.title: Lake light and time for two
itinerary.description: Arrive and settle into the hotel or houseboat selected for your quote. Keep the first day light. A shikara outing or lakeside tea can be planned around your arrival, with private dining, room decoration and photography available as separately quoted choices.
experiences: A lakeside welcome at your own pace
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: A mountain stay in Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Travel towards Gulmarg with a comfortable stop around Tangmarg. Arrive with daylight to settle into your chosen room and enjoy the landscape. Confirm heating, hot-water arrangements and any winter access vehicle in the written quote.

itinerary.title: One place, a whole day
itinerary.description: Give Gulmarg a full day without changing hotels. Choose a Gondola trip with the exact phase and tickets confirmed, or keep the day quieter around lower paths and warm indoor breaks. Snow activities remain optional; weather can change the day’s plan.
experiences: A ticketed mountain outing by arrangement

itinerary.title: Across to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Set out early for Pahalgam, choosing one convenient stop en route rather than rushing a list of attractions. After checking in, leave space for tea, the riverside and a quiet evening.
experiences: A considered road day with breaks

itinerary.title: Choose your valley day
itinerary.description: Choose Aru or Betaab for a focused outing, with current access and local transport agreed beforehand. You can also keep the day in Pahalgam if you prefer fewer transfers. Photography, pony activities and special meals are optional additions, never assumed in the guide price.
experiences: One valley explored at a comfortable pace

itinerary.title: Srinagar, stories and a final evening
itinerary.description: Return to Srinagar and choose a short city experience around your arrival. An appointed craft visit, a focused heritage walk or a lakefront finish can work well. A houseboat upgrade is discussed in advance, with winter comfort and the room category identified in your quote.

experiences: A private heritage or craft experience by arrangement

extensions.title: One more Pahalgam valley day
extensions.description: Request two nights for a slower Pahalgam stay, choosing Aru or Betaab on separate outings rather than rushing both. This may change the main route; local transport, entry charges, hotel and extra cost are quoted separately.

extensions.title: Southern springs with an overnight
extensions.description: Discuss a separate Kokernag or Daksum-area night so the southern valley has its own time. The overnight base, road access, heating and return route need confirmation rather than being added to a busy transfer day.
